thermodynamic_system.target: unbiased pure water around the hash-bound ghost solute observation volume

schedule.bias_scales: unique and strictly monotonic in either direction
schedule.target_state_index: explicit unique index whose bias scale is 0
schedule.full_field_state_index: explicit unique index whose bias scale is 1
runtime_identity_validation: canonical oxygen atom index map equals oxygen_atom_map_hash
canonical runtime periodic cell equals cell_hash
schedule boundary_adapter_hash equals the cavity periodic adapter hash
schedule active_occupancy_max equals the runtime cavity active support
schedule.implemented_ensemble: NVT only with pressure_bar=null; NPT requires a future variable-cell, stress, PV and volume-measure implementation
schedule.active_occupancy_max: integer nmax>=1 defining active support n=0..nmax; n=0-only packing artifacts cannot enter the production occupancy ledger
schedule.full_support_zero_tail_allowed: nmax may equal the number of explicit solvent molecules, in which case the aggregate overflow tail is exactly zero

water_hamiltonian_policy.requirement: explicitly identified checkpoint with verified periodic bulk-water support under the declared ensemble

analysis.primary_estimator: MBAR free-energy difference at explicit target and full-field indices
analysis.energy_conversion: RT is derived only from schedule.temperature_k and the canonical gas constant
analysis.packing_occupancy_bridge: packing MBAR and reference p(n) share the exact reduced-potential table, frame order, omega0 values, membership, boundary adapter, active support, measure hashes and uncertainty gate
analysis.estimator_agreement_uncertainty: state-stratified paired bootstrap of both estimators on every resampled reduced-potential table; independent-error hypot is forbidden
analysis.paired_bootstrap_evidence: replicate count, seed, paired-estimate hash, covariance and direct difference standard errors are content-hash bound
